Text:
# SUSPECTED BACTEREMIA, BLOOD CULTURES NOT YET POSITIVE

If blood cultures are positive, return to the previous menu and make a selection based on the interim results.

# Choice of antimicrobials

Select antimicrobials active against any suspected site of infection that may be present. Return to main menu and refer to the source infection's page within the Antimicrobial CDSS.

# For patients with an intravascular catheter, refer to the intravascular- associated infection page

[Intravascular Catheter-Associated Infection](catheter-associated-infection-intravascular)

Therapy:
## Empirical therapy for mild to moderate infection, focal infection not found

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) M

## Empirical therapy for severe infection

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) M < AND > Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) R

## Empirical therapy for immunosuppressed patients

Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q8h ($$) [R] extended infusion <AND> Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]

## For patients with penicillin allergy

vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) R <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg q24h ($) R,O

## Emergency department: initial STAT doses

### Empirical therapy for mild to moderate infection, focal infection not found

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [M]

### Empirical therapy for severe infection

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [M] < AND > vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT ($) [R]

### Empirical therapy for immunosuppressed patients

Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT ($$) <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT ($) [R]

### For patients with penicillin allergy

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT ($) [R] <AND> aztreonam 2 gm IV once STAT ($$$$) [R]
